flyer.justification: The flyer adheres well to format constraints with a short title, impact points, and placeholder logistics, accurately reflecting the transcript content.

instagram.justification: The post perfectly follows all Instagram formatting requirements including emojis, visual carousel cues, CTA, and 11 targeted hashtags.

newsletter.justification: The newsletter follows all format rules, including a short subject line under 50 characters, editorial tone, and bold subheadings.

linkedin.justification: The content is well-written and avoids clichés/filler words, but missed the requirement to include 3-5 relevant hashtags.

summary.justification: An excellent executive briefing under 400 words adhering strictly to the structured Markdown format requirement.

blog.justification: An exemplary long-form blog post that thoroughly covers all key points of the talk with a clear table, numbered sections, and author profile.
